en.headline: Pedestrian hit by taxi in Sau Mau Ping, semi-conscious in hospital
en.dek: A man was struck near Po Tat Estate on Po Lam Road at about 9:51am and was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital; police are investigating whether a red light was involved.
body: A pedestrian was seriously injured when he was hit by a taxi near Po Tat Estate in Sau Mau Ping on Monday morning. Police received reports at about 9:51am that a man had been knocked down on Po Lam Road.

According to reports, a red taxi travelling towards Tseung Kwan O failed to stop in time and struck a man who was crossing at a pedestrian crossing. The man was thrown some distance and was found semi-conscious with a head injury. Ambulance crews took him to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for treatment.
The front left side of the taxi was damaged. Police are investigating the cause of the collision and whether anyone ran a red light.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪男途人捱的士撞 半昏迷送院
zh.dek: 周一上午約9時51分，一名男子在寶琳路寶達邨對開過馬路時被的士撞倒，頭傷半昏迷送伊利沙伯醫院，警方調查是否有人衝燈。
body: 周一上午約9時51分，警方接獲報案，指秀茂坪寶達邨對開寶琳路發生交通意外，一輛的士撞倒一名男途人。
現場消息指，一輛紅色的士沿寶琳路往將軍澳方向行駛，駛至寶達邨對開燈位時收掣不及，撞倒一名正在行人過路處橫過馬路的男子。男子飛彈後倒地，頭傷呈半昏迷狀態，由救護員送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。的士左邊車頭及燈罩損毀。
警方正調查意外原因，不排除有人衝紅燈肇禍。
